title: 9 officials promoted in Chhattisgarh, new roles effective immediately
summary: The government of Chhattisgarh has promoted nine officials and employees within the Ministry of Personnel. The promotions are effective immediately, with new roles assigned to the individuals. The changes were announced by the state administration, which also stated that officers and employees who have been on the same desk for over three years will be rotated out. No further details were provided.
summary_points: The government of Chhattisgarh has promoted nine officials and employees within the Ministry of Personnel.
The promotions are effective immediately, with new roles assigned to the individuals.
Officers and employees who have been on the same desk for over three years will be rotated out.
No further details were provided about the reasons behind the promotions or the impact on the state administration.
The changes were announced by the state administration without specifying when they would take effect.

summary_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ सरकार ने मंत्रालय विभाग में 9 अधिकारी-कर्मचारियों को पदोन्नति दी है, नई जिम्मेदारी तत्काल प्रभाव से मिल गई है।
summary_points_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ सरकार ने मंत्रालय विभाग में 9 अधिकारी-कर्मचारियों को पदोन्नति दी है.
नई जिम्मेदारी तत्काल प्रभाव से मिल गई है।
अधिकारी और कर्मचारी जिन्होंने 3 साल से अधिक समय तक एक ही डेस्क पर रहे हैं, उनको बदलेगी कुर्सी।
कोई और विवरण नहीं दिया गया है कि पदोन्नति के पीछे क्या कारण हैं या यह सरकार की स्थिति पर कैसे प्रभाव डालेगा।
सरकार ने बदलावों की घोषणा की बिना कहा कि जब तक वे लागू नहीं होते।
